text: さいきんじゃ　このへんも　さわがしく　なって　あんまり　いいのが　つれないねえ

structure.jp: このへんも　さわがしく　なって
structure.en: it's gotten noisy around here too, and

structure.jp: あんまり　いいのが　つれないねえ
structure.en: I can't hook many good ones, eh

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: じゃ here is the spoken short form of では, which sets the scene: 'as for this time'. さいきんじゃ = 'these days'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.span: さわがしく　なって
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus なる, means 'become that way'. さわがしく　なって = 'it has become noisy, and'.

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands for a thing already understood, like 'one' in English; here it means a fish or Pokémon. いいの = 'a good one'.
